Crucial 16GB DDR5 5600MHz SODIMM CL46 High-Performance Laptop RAM Memory Module

Boost your notebook's multitasking capabilities and processing speed with the Crucial 16GB DDR5 5600MHz SODIMM laptop RAM memory module, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Specifically engineered for modern laptops and mobile workstations, this premium JEDEC standard single module features a blistering 5600MT/s transfer speed combined with a stable CL46 latency profile, ensuring smooth application handling and eliminated system bottlenecks. Built utilizing next-generation DDR5 technology, it operates at an ultra-efficient 1.1V low power threshold layout to preserve your device's battery runtime while generating less heat. Easy to install and widely compatible with high-end Intel and AMD portable platforms, this essential laptop memory upgrade structure comes fully backed by a reliable 1-year warranty plan.
